description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong>InMobi Advertising</strong>&nbsp;is a global technology leader helping marketers win the moments that matter. Our advertising platform reaches over 2 billion people across 150+ countries and turns real-time context into business outcomes, delivering results grounded in privacy-first principles. Trusted by 30,000+ brands and leading publishers, InMobi is where intelligence, creativity, and accountability converge. By combining lock screens, apps, TVs, and the open web with AI and machine learning, we deliver receptive attention, precise personalization, and measurable impact.</p> <p>Through <strong>Glance AI,</strong>&nbsp;we are shaping AI Commerce, reimagining the future of e-commerce with inspiration-led discovery and shopping. Designed to seamlessly integrate into everyday consumer technology, Glance AI transforms every screen into a gateway for instant, personal, and joyful discovery.&nbsp; Spanning diverse categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and beyond, Glance AI delivers deeply personalized shopping experiences.&nbsp;With rich first-party data and unparalleled consumer access, it harnesses InMobi’s global scale, insights, and targeting capabilities to create high impact, performance driven shopping journeys for brands worldwide.</p> <p>Recognized as a Great Place to Work, and by MIT Technology Review, Fast Company’s Top 10 Innovators, and more, InMobi is a workplace where bold ideas create global impact. Backed by investors including SoftBank, Kleiner Perkins, and Sherpalo Ventures, InMobi has offices across San Mateo, New York, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Bengaluru and beyond.</p> <p>At<strong>&nbsp;InMobi Advertising</strong>, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how billions of users connect with content, commerce, and brands worldwide. To learn more, visit <a id="menur1hur" class="fui-Link ___1q1shib f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1s184ao f1mk8lai fnbmjn9 f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="http://www.inmobi.com/" target="_blank">www.inmobi.com</a></p> <p></p></div><p><strong>Who are we and What do we do?</strong></p> <p>InMobi is a global provider of enterprise platform for marketers. Our platforms help Marketers reach 1.56 billion unique users through mobile to help them engage, acquire, re-engage, re-market and retain valuable users. InMobi is also India’s first unicorn and one of the only profitable global tech-product companies to emerge out of India.</p> <p>&nbsp;At 20+ offices across the globe, InMobi employs over 1000 personnel constituting 25 nationalities. Acclaimed for its culture, InMobi has consecutively featured on the Great Places to Work (GPTW) list, with a consistent hold in the Top 50 position for the past two years. Moreover, these accolades are not just restricted to India, InMobi has also secured a ranking on the GPTW’s 2017 China List, a notable feat for an Indian startup.</p> <p>InMobi has also regularly featured on world disruptor lists<strong> – </strong>MIT Technology Review’s 2013 50 Disruptive Companies; Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies for 2016, 2018; CNBC’s Disruptor 50 list of 2018, here InMobi was selected amongst a pool of more than 980 forward-thinking and ambitiou private companies across the globe, we now share this space with the likes of SpaceX, Airbnb, Uber and so on.</p> <p><strong>What is the InMobi family like? </strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are an infectious bunch. Be it the way we rise to challenges, the innovative products we create, the dreams we chase or the fun we have at work. We are sure that if you meet us, you will be infected too. Today, we are proud to be the leaders in Mobile advertising and are on an accelerated path of being a leader in enterprise software for marketers. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion. We are here today because a few of us did just that.</p> <p><strong>What can we promise? </strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>We offer you an opportunity to work on building enterprise platforms that require you to acquire, hone and demonstrate your engineering skills in designing and solving for complex problems, thereby creating software that creates value for our customers in a reliable, scalable, secure, and AI-first manner. At InMobi, you get to work on innovative technologies, work closely with business teams and grow as an overall technology leader.</p> <p>Modern work environment, flexible schedule, and smart, creative, down-to-earth people. Internal opportunities to move roles and try out bridge assignments with different teams.&nbsp; Food for your soul – free meals all days of the week, gym, or Yoga class to flex those biceps, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.</p> <p><strong>What is the team like?</strong></p> <p class="p1"><strong>We are the CDR-AI team at InMobi, focused on building a next-generation Reporting, Analytics, and AI platform. Our mission is to transform raw data into actionable business insights for internal consumers while enabling seamless integration with multiple business and technology platforms.</strong></p> <p class="p1">As a platform team, we work closely with different lines of business across InMobi to understand their reporting, analytics, automation, and AI-driven decisioning needs. This gives the team a unique opportunity to solve high-impact business problems while working on large-scale data, analytics, and GenAI systems.</p> <p class="p1">In addition to reporting and analytics, the team is expanding into AI engineering areas such as <span class="s1"><strong>Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, and MCP-based integrations</strong></span>. We also work across cloud and AI platforms including <span class="s1"><strong>GCP, Microsoft Azure, databases, GKE, REST APIs, and modern deployment frameworks</strong></span>. Microsoft positions Azure AI as an enterprise-grade platform for building AI apps and agents, which aligns with the team’s direction toward scalable AI-led platform capabilities.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <p class="p1"><strong>Key technology areas:</strong><br>AI/ML Engineering, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, MCP, Python, REST API Development, Spark, Java/J2EE, Airflow, Databricks, GKE, GCP, Microsoft Azure, Databases, Caching, Big Data Analytics.</p> <p class="p1">&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What will you be doing?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as an independent senior engineer, owning complex problem statements and delivering scalable, reliable solutions aligned with business goals.</li> <li>Stay current with emerging technologies such as Agentic AI, Generative AI, and Copilot Studio, while mentoring the team on adoption and best practices.</li> <li>Collaborate with product, business, data, and engineering stakeholders, and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Participate actively in architecture discussions, design reviews, sprint planning, and technical decision-making.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What do we expect from you? </strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Design and build LLM-powered applications, chatbots, copilots, and multi-agent workflows</li> <li>Implement GenAI solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, n8n, or similar.</li> <li>Build and maintain prompt templates, chains, agents, tools, and reusable AI workflows.</li> <li>Integrate vector databases for semantic search, contextual retrieval, RAG, and memory.</li> <li>Develop backend services, REST APIs, and integrations to run AI models in production.</li> <li>Ensure AI solutions are explainable, accurate, compliant, secure, and aligned with finance policies.</li> <li>Monitor and evaluate model and workflow performance on an ongoing basis.</li> <li>Optimize inference cost, latency, reliability, and overall system efficiency.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product, Data, Business, Sales, Finance, and Engineering teams to deliver end-to-end AI solutions.</li> <li>Stay updated on emerging GenAI, AI/ML, agentic AI, and automation technologies.</li> <li>Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, technical discussions, and architecture reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications &amp; Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or a related engineering discipline.</li> <li>3–5 years of software development experience with hands-on expertise in <span class="s1"><strong>Python, SQL, TensorFlow/PyTorch</strong></span>, and modern AI/ML frameworks.</li> <li>Experience designing and building <span class="s1"><strong>LLM-powered applications</strong></span>, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector search, and fine-tuning pipelines.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with <span class="s1"><strong>agentic AI frameworks</strong></span> such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, n8n, or ReAct-style agents. LangGraph is designed for customizable single-agent, multi-agent, and human-in-the-loop workflows. <span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Strong experience building <span class="s1"><strong>REST APIs, microservices, and backend systems</strong></span> for production-grade applications.</li> <li>Experience with <span class="s1"><strong>Model Context Protocol (MCP)</strong></span>, including building or integrating MCP tools, servers, or capabilities. MCP enables servers to expose tools that language models can invoke to interact with external systems such as APIs, databases, and computation services. <span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Good understanding of <span class="s1"><strong>CI/CD, Docker, and containerized application development</strong></span>. Docker provides a standard way to package and run applications in lightweight containers with their dependencies. <span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Working knowledge of <span class="s1"><strong>data pipelines, APIs, databases, and cloud platforms</strong></span> such as Azure, GCP, or AWS.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills, with the ability to work effectively in agile engineering environments.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;<strong>Nice to have skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience of online advertising domain</li> <li>Experience of working on massively large-scale data systems in production environments</li> <li>Experience of Big Data analytics domain</li> <li>Experience of building AI products that are powered by data and insights</li> <li>Worked with Enterprise Applications like SaleForce, MS dynamics</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>The InMobi Culture</strong></p> <p>At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.</p> <p>We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.</p> <p>We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.</p> <p>InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.</p> <p>Visit&nbsp;<a class="fui-Link ___1rxvrpe f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1hu3pq6 f11qmguv f19f4twv f1tyq0we f1g0x7ka fhxju0i f1qch9an f1cnd47f fqv5qza f1vmzxwi f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.inmobi.com%2Fcompany%2Fcareers&amp;data=05%7C02%7Crichard.thomas%40inmobi.com%7Ce97eb886aa4d4c8e919608dc52d1cc2f%7C89359cf49e60409980c4775a0cfe27a7%7C0%7C0%7C638476308219536812%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=FOJ4DKK6f1jjlteD9SlK%2FdMDUaZzdYsCFSU%2BX%2BvuCAo%3D&amp;reserved=0" target="_blank">https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers</a> to better understand our benefits, values, and more!</p></div>

If you are too, let's talk.</p></div><h2><strong>iOS Engineer – Universal Components</strong></h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is to free everyone to safely use any technology. So, if you’re a big thinker who is nimble and adaptable, Okta may be an ideal place to shine.</p> <p>Okta’s Customer Identity Cloud (CIC), powered by Auth0 technology, is an easy-to-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier 0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.</p> <p>We are looking for a collaborative, developer-focused <strong>SDE2 iOS Engineer</strong> to join our <strong>Universal Components</strong> team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Job Description</strong></h3> <p><strong>You UNDERSTAND developers!</strong> You know what they need, how to talk to them, how to make their lives easier, and what turns friction into delight. You recognize when a framework, library, or product provides an exceptional developer experience.</p> <p>As an iOS Engineer on the Universal Components team, you will leverage that developer-first mindset to build and maintain our open-source UI components and SDKs. You will contribute to refining our entire developer journey—from onboarding, quickstarts, and documentation to providing direct assistance in developer channels. Your contributions will directly reach thousands of customer applications and carry a high impact across the mobile ecosystem.</p> <p>You will act as an internal and external advocate for the iOS platforms and technologies you work with daily. Collaborating in a cross-functional environment alongside developer relations, onboarding, growth, dashboard, and core SDK teams, you will help deliver a world-class experience for our component libraries.</p> <p>The most vital qualifications for this position are solid software engineering fundamentals, strong empathy for developers, and a collaborative mindset.</p> <p><br><br></p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Be Doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Building Modular UI:</strong> Designing and developing composable, high-quality UI components from the ground up using SwiftUI.</li> <li><strong>SDK Development:</strong> Shaping and evolving our open-source Universal Components iOS SDK, ensuring seamless integration with core identity and authentication services.</li> <li><strong>Authoring Developer Resources:</strong> Writing, curating, and polishing technical content, including tutorials, guides, sample applications, and clear documentation.</li> <li><strong>Community &amp; Advocacy:</strong> Engaging directly with the open-source developer community, championing modern developer experience, and providing technical support.</li> <li><strong>Code Quality &amp; Domain Expertise:</strong> Serving as a key technical contributor by providing domain knowledge, participating in code reviews, and upholding quality standards across our iOS projects.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge Sharing:</strong> Representing the team's technical expertise at developer events, community forums, or through technical blog posts.</li> <li><strong>Maintenance &amp; Modernization:</strong> Troubleshooting, fixing, and maintaining client libraries while staying up to date with modern Apple frameworks and platforms.</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Bring to the Role</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>3+ years</strong> of professional experience in native iOS development.</li> <li><strong>2+ years</strong> of hands-on experience building production interfaces in SwiftUI.</li> <li>Ability to seamlessly translate design mocks (e.g., Figma) into clean, modular, and accessible SwiftUI code.</li> <li>A strong interest in developing reusable iOS libraries and SDKs consumed by third-party developers.</li> <li>Solid understanding of modern iOS frameworks, Swift best practices, and the broader Apple ecosystem.</li> <li>Experience building or contributing to at least one shipped iOS application or public SDK using SwiftUI.</li> <li>Practical understanding of modern dependency managers and SDK distribution methods (e.g., Swift Package Manager, Carthage).</li> <li>Familiarity with CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions, CircleCI) and running automated mobile tests in continuous integration pipelines.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills with a proven track record of authoring developer documentation or technical content.</li> <li>A collaborative approach to engineering, with the ability to self-direct and execute independently while thriving in a globally distributed team.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points If You Have</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Knowledge or hands-on experience with Design Systems</strong> (building component libraries, design tokens, or multi-platform visual consistency).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with <strong>UIKit</strong> and handling hybrid SwiftUI/UIKit architectures.</li> <li>Experience working in remote or distributed team environments.</li> <li>Experience with <strong>Android</strong> (Kotlin &amp; Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an AI Engineer at GitLab, you'll help build the foundation for GitLab's transformation into an AI-first company. Reporting to the Director, Enterprise AI, you'll be a hands-on technical leader responsible for delivering internal AI-powered solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.</p> <p>Building fast matters, but it's not enough on its own. This role starts with understanding the real problem: mapping how work moves across teams, tools, and handoffs, identifying the true constraint, and validating whether AI is the right solution before you begin development. From there, you'll take ownership from discovery through deployment, combining strong engineering skills with systems thinking and business understanding.</p> <p>Your initial focus will span Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support, where you will embed AI solutions into key systems and workflows. This role offers the opportunity to shape how GitLab team members work, improve flow across the organization, and help advance our mission in a remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Diagnose business problems before building solutions. Map workflows, identify constraints, and confirm whether AI is the right intervention. Be prepared to say "this doesn't need AI" when that's the honest answer.</li> <li>Own AI initiatives end-to-end, from stakeholder discovery and technical design through implementation, deployment, and iteration.</li> <li>Design, develop, and ship AI-powered solutions quickly, delivering working prototypes in days, not months, with a focus on practical outcomes and measurable business value.</li> <li>Improve organizational flow by building solutions that reduce bottlenecks, shorten lead times, and increase throughput. Measure success using flow metrics alongside adoption and ROI.</li> <li>Integrate AI capabilities into existing systems and workflows using APIs, orchestration tools, and modern AI platforms, including GitLab Duo Agent Platform, where appropriate. The right tool wins, whether that's custom code, a platform, or a well-crafted prompt.</li> <li>Be Customer Zero: leverage and showcase GitLab's AI offerings wherever possible, feeding real-world usage insights back to R&amp;D.</li> <li>Partner closely with stakeholders across functions to understand the real constraints. Ask the right questions, bridge technical and non-technical perspectives, and align on outcomes before jumping to solutions.</li> <li>Define and track success through business metrics, flow metrics, and feedback loops that make performance visible and actionable.</li> <li>Contribute to technical direction by evaluating tools, documenting patterns, and creating reusable foundations that help the team scale its impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>A Technologist at Heart -&nbsp;</strong>Genuinely invested in technology, the foundational and the cutting-edge in equal measure. You're as energised by a well-designed API integration as you are by the latest foundation model release. AI is a powerful part of your toolkit, but it sits on top of solid engineering fundamentals, not in place of them.</li> <li><strong>Competent, Confident Coding Skills -&nbsp;</strong>You can build working solutions end-to-end, write clean and maintainable code, and debug effectively. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.&nbsp;</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> </div></div><h2>Available Locations</h2><ul><li>India</li></ul><h2>About the Role</h2><p><strong>About the Role</strong> At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As the architectural complexity of enterprise solutions scales, we are evolving how we partner with our customers. The Customer Engineer (CE) represents the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted advisor who owns the technical relationship from the initial discovery phase through to long-term adoption and ongoing account expansion.</p><p>Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to the Regional Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, utilizing AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p><h2>Responsibilities</h2><ul><li><strong>Technical Validation:</strong> Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, build bespoke architectures, and deliver compelling product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) across Cloudflare’s portfolio (Security, Networking and Developer Platforms).</li><li><strong>Trusted Advisory:</strong> Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion.</li><li><strong>Strategic Alignment:</strong> Own the long-term technical relationship across the entire customer lifecycle, ensuring continuous alignment between the customer’s evolving business goals and our product roadmap.</li><li><strong>Commercial Accountability &amp; Expansion:</strong> Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. You will be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li><li><strong>AI Orchestration &amp; Workflow Automation:</strong> Act as an "AI-Augmented" engineer. Leverage AI agents and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, and basic telemetry monitoring, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li></ul><h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2><ul><li><strong>Experience:</strong> Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Sales Engineering, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li><li><strong>Technical Acumen:</strong> Broad technical expertise spanning web security, networking (routing, DNS, DDoS mitigation), cloud infrastructure, and enterprise architecture.</li><li><strong>Commercial Mindset:</strong> Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li><li><strong>Communication:</strong> Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li><li><strong>Cloudflare Developer Stack Experience:</strong> Hands-on experience building, deploying, or architecting solutions using Cloudflare's developer platform and AI ecosystem, specifically Workers AI and AI Gateway.</li><li><strong>Applied AI Knowledge:</strong> Experience with prompt engineering, Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.</li><li><strong>Coding/Scripting:</strong> Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li></ul><h2>Misc.</h2><ul><li><strong>Please note: This role will require you to be based in Mumbai.</strong></li></ul><h2>Compensation</h2><p><strong>Compensation</strong> This role features a competitive base salary and a variable commission structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">GAQ126R44</p> <h2>About Databricks</h2> <p>At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems—and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business.</p> <p>We're looking for a SAP Developer to build the applications, extensions, and integrations that bring this vision to life. In this role, <strong>you'll write clean-core extensions on SAP BTP, build full-stack apps and Fiori experiences, wire up integrations between SAP and the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, and help embed AI and agentic capabilities directly into finance workflows.</strong> You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI—shipping software that makes finance operations faster, smarter, and more automated.</p> <h2>The Opportunity</h2> <p>SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As an SAP Developer, you'll be hands-on-keyboard building the layer that makes those processes intelligent: side-by-side extensions on BTP, event-driven integrations into the Lakehouse, and AI-assisted workflows that automate routine work and guide users through exceptions and approvals. You'll build with modern SAP and Databricks AI tooling—combining SAP’s core ERP capabilities with Databricks-native AI, agentic applications, and automation—while keeping the SAP digital core clean, scalable, and upgradable. Your mission is to turn designs into robust, production-grade software that combines the strength of SAP with the power of Databricks AI.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Build Clean-Core Extensions:</strong> Develop in-app and side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP that keep the S/4HANA digital core clean and upgrade-ready, using released APIs and extension points rather than core modifications.</li> <li><strong>Develop Databricks-Native Applications:</strong> Build scalable, full-stack applications and services on the Databricks platform that extend and integrate with SAP, leveraging Databricks-native capabilities, APIs, data services, and AI/agentic tooling to deliver modern Finance experiences while keeping the SAP core clean.</li> <li><strong>Build Integrations:</strong> Implement secure, resilient integrations across SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP Integration Suite, event-driven patterns, APIs, OData v4, and change-data feeds into the Databricks Lakehouse, with solid error handling and monitoring.</li> <li><strong>Embed AI &amp; Agentic Capabilities:</strong> Build AI-powered and agentic capabilities into Finance workflows using Databricks AI, integrating seamlessly with SAP and other enterprise systems. Apply RAG, prompt engineering, tool calling, and human-in-the-loop controls to automate processes safely while maintaining governance and auditability</li> <li><strong>Move SAP Data to the Lakehouse:</strong> Partner with data engineering to build the pipelines and extraction patterns (CDC, OData, APIs) that land SAP data in Databricks cleanly, with attention to modeling, lineage, and data quality.</li> <li><strong>Engineer for Quality:</strong> Write unit and integration tests, work within CI/CD and transport pipelines for ABAP and BTP artifacts, participate in code reviews, and follow the team's security and coding standards.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate:</strong> Work closely with the technical lead, functional experts, and product owners to turn requirements and designs into working software, and iterate quickly based on user feedback.</li> </ul> <h2>What You Bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>6+ years of SAP development experience</strong>, with hands-on delivery of at least one end-to-end SAP solution (an S/4HANA extension, a CAP or RAP app on BTP with Fiori, or an Integration Suite flow) in production.</li> <li><strong>Modern ABAP:</strong> Strong command of ABAP Cloud, ABAP CDS, and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP), plus OData (v2/v4).</li> <li><strong>SAP BTP:</strong> Working-to-advanced experience with BTP runtimes, core services (Connectivity, Destination, XSUAA/auth), and deploying, securing, and operating apps on the platform.</li> <li><strong>Front End:</strong> Solid experience with SAP Fiori concepts, SAPUI5, and Fiori Elements (OData v4).</li> <li><strong>Integration:</strong> Experience with SAP Integration Suite / API Management and event-driven patterns (OData/REST, IDoc, Cloud Integration, Event Mesh) across
